newsitem.title: MEXICO: IFC grants $44 mln loan to Cemento de El Salvador.
newsitem.headline: IFC grants $44 mln loan to Cemento de El Salvador.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) said on Monday it agreed to loan $44 million to Cemento de El Salvador (CESSA).
IFC said in a statement it took an equity share of up to $2 million in the company.
"IFC's support will assist CESSA with the company's expansion and modernization project, which will increase overall capacity by 55 percent," the statement said.
The project includes a $82.9 million new cement line, with a clinker production capacity of 2,200 tonnes per day.

"An adequate supply of competitively priced cement, in particular, is considered critical to reconstruction following the extensive damage to physical infrastructure inflicted during the civil conflict," the IFC said.
